title: iGEM 2018 Interlab Study Protocol: Calibration 1
author: Ylenia Longo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qncdvaw

steps.title: Add LUDOX to wells
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of LUDOX solution into wells A1, B1, C1, and D1 of a 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Add ddH2O to wells
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of ddH₂O into wells A2, B2, C2, and D2 of the same 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Measure absorbance at 600 nm
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of all wells at 600 nm, using the same measurement mode that will be employed for subsequent cell measurements.

steps.title: Import data into Excel sheet
steps.instruction: Import the recorded absorbance values into the iGEM‑provided Excel file, specifically the “OD600 reference point” tab.
